title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #9 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is a result of disobedience? (1 mark)
   A. Reward
   B. Trust
   C. Praise
   D. Punishment or harm

2. Which is a school rule? (1 mark)
   A. Arrive on time
   B. Fight freely
   C. Skip lessons
   D. Litter

3. Which of these shows love at school? (1 mark)
   A. Welcoming a new pupil
   B. Refusing to greet
   C. Laughing at new pupils
   D. Hiding books

4. Which command did Jesus give in John 13:34? (1 mark)
   A. Fast
   B. Give money
   C. Love one another
   D. Go to the temple

5. Why is it important to care for personal items? (1 mark)
   A. They look bad
   B. They are unimportant
   C. They are free
   D. They last longer and save money

6. Which of these shows respect for others' bodies? (1 mark)
   A. Hitting
   B. Bullying
   C. Not hitting or bullying
   D. Touching without permission

7. In 1 Corinthians 6:19, what does Paul call the body of a believer? (1 mark)
   A. Toys
   B. Machines
   C. Property of strangers
   D. Temples of the Holy Spirit

8. Why is the church called the house of God? (1 mark)
   A. It is a school
   B. It is a farm
   C. It is a holy place for worship
   D. It is a shop

9. What should we do with phones in church? (1 mark)
   A. Watch videos
   B. Switch them off or keep them silent
   C. Make calls
   D. Play games

10. How many disciples did Jesus choose? (1 mark)
   A. Ten
   B. Seven
   C. Twenty
   D. Twelve

11. Who replaced Judas among the twelve? (1 mark)
   A. Barnabas
   B. Stephen
   C. Paul
   D. Matthias

12. What does it mean to stand firm in faith? (1 mark)
   A. To copy others
   B. To hide
   C. To give up
   D. To keep believing and doing right under pressure

13. What should you do if a group invites you to do something wrong? (1 mark)
   A. Keep it secret
   B. Ask for more
   C. Join in
   D. Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult

14. Who taught the disciples the Lord's Prayer? (1 mark)
   A. Peter
   B. John
   C. Jesus
   D. Moses

15. What does "lead us not into temptation" ask? (1 mark)
   A. That God hides us
   B. That God punishes us
   C. That God gives gifts
   D. That God keeps us from doing wrong

16. How can we grow the fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Only sleep
   B. Pray, read the Bible and practise
   C. Ignore the Bible
   D. Only watch TV

17. Which of these is a fruit of the Spirit? (1 mark)
   A. Kindness
   B. Anger
   C. Jealousy
   D. Greed

18. Which action shows self-control? (1 mark)
   A. Pushing in a queue
   B. Waiting for your turn
   C. Taking others' things
   D. Shouting

19. What does Philippians 4:8 encourage us to think about? (1 mark)
   A. Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   B. Whatever hurts
   C. Whatever is unkind
   D. Whatever is false

20. Which of these is a digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A mobile phone
   B. A chair
   C. A stone
   D. A pencil

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain the lessons that we learn from Matthew 21:12-14. (5 marks)

22. Explain why Jesus cleared the temple. (3 marks)

23. Explain how a child can show honour to parents in four ways. (4 marks)

24. Explain why obedience is important at home and at school, and when a child should not obey. (5 marks)

25. List six of the twelve disciples. (3 marks)

26. State three rules for safe use of social media. (3 marks)

27. Describe four ways in which a child can stand firm in their Christian faith. (4 marks)

28. Outline three results of disobedience. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Punishment or harm
   Disobedience brings trouble.

2. A — Arrive on time
   Being on time is a common school rule.

3. A — Welcoming a new pupil
   Welcoming is kind.

4. C — Love one another
   Jesus said to love as He loved.

5. D — They last longer and save money
   Care reduces loss.

6. C — Not hitting or bullying
   We respect others as God's creation.

7. D — Temples of the Holy Spirit
   The body is a temple.

8. C — It is a holy place for worship
   Believers meet there to worship God.

9. B — Switch them off or keep them silent
   Phones can disturb worship.

10. D — Twelve
   Matthew 10:1 speaks of twelve.

11. D — Matthias
   Acts 1:26 says Matthias was chosen.

12. D — To keep believing and doing right under pressure
   Standing firm means not giving in.

13. D — Say no, walk away and tell a trusted adult
   Refuse and seek help.

14. C — Jesus
   Jesus taught it when asked.

15. D — That God keeps us from doing wrong
   We ask protection from temptation.

16. B — Pray, read the Bible and practise
   Practice and prayer help.

17. A — Kindness
   Kindness is listed.

18. B — Waiting for your turn
   Waiting is self-control.

19. A — Whatever is true, pure and lovely
   Philippians 4:8.

20. A — A mobile phone
   A phone is an electronic device.

SECTION B
----
21. (5 marks)
   Answer: The house of God is holy; it is for prayer; we must not misuse it or cheat others; Jesus cares about what happens there; it is a place of healing and help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson up to 5.

22. (3 marks)
   Answer: The temple was meant for prayer but people used it to make money and cheat. Jesus cared for the honour of His Father's house.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for prayer purpose, 1 for making money or cheating, 1 for honour of God's house.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Greet politely, obey cheerfully, help with chores, speak kindly, say thank you, pray for them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way up to 4.

24. (5 marks)
   Answer: Obedience brings peace at home, safety and learning at school. It pleases God. A child should not obey instructions that are unsafe or hurt them or others. In that case they should say no and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for home peace, 1 for school learning, 1 for pleasing God, 1 for not obeying harmful instructions, 1 for telling a trusted adult.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Peter, Andrew, James, John, Philip, Bartholomew, Thomas, Matthew, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each two correct names up to 3 marks.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ask permission, do not chat with strangers, do not share personal details, be kind, limit time.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray, read the Bible, say no to wrong, be proud to be a Christian, join a good church group, ask God for courage.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

28. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.
